headline: European Commission Imposes 27.9% Anti-Dumping Tariff on Japanese Steel
summary: The European Commission imposed a 27.9 per cent anti-dumping tariff on Japanese cold-rolled steel used in automotive and home appliance manufacturing, citing unfairly low import prices.
why: Tariffs on industrial raw materials protect domestic manufacturing sectors but can alter international trade flows and raise input costs for downstream industries.

impacts.name: Steel
impacts.why: Imposition of high anti-dumping tariffs restricts export competitiveness of Japanese steel manufacturers in the European market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
